content.text: You're in Zimbabwe, and Stripe won't let you sell your ebooks or courses online - a restriction that's sadly common across the world, particularly in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines - but you're not alone, and there's a better way to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-digital-product-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-costing-you|Why Payment]]-solutions-west-africa-costing|digital]] products without relying on Stripe or any other centralized platform. With Cloudflare R2, NOWPayments, and our Sovereign Stack, you can deploy a fully operational digital commerce infrastructure that's yours to keep, configure, and scale.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service that lets you store and deliver digital products directly to your customers - and with NOWPayments, you can accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]currency payments with a 0.5% fee, a tiny fraction of what platforms like Gumroad charge with their 10% commission. The Sovereign Stack is our all-in-one infrastructure solution that combines Cloudflare R2, NOWPayments, and other free tools to let you deploy a fully operational digital commerce stack that's yours to own and control - no subscriptions, no platform fees, and no restrictions on where you can sell your digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of our Sovereign Stack is Cloudflare R2, which provides a scalable and secure storage solution for your digital products. With Cloudflare Workers, we create a custom backend that automates file delivery and processing, while NOWPayments handles cryptocurrency payments and automatic webhook notifications. Supabase and Google Sheets serve as our order storage and database, respectively, ensuring seamless integration and scalability. Our infrastructure configuration ensures fast and reliable delivery of your digital products to customers worldwide, with automatic conversions to USD for seamless pricing.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Our Sovereign Stack is designed for digital creators who want to sell their ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software without relying on centralized platforms like Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad - whether you're in a country with platform restrictions or simply want to keep your business independent. With our solution, you can sell digital products directly to your customers, without giving up any control or profits. You're not locked into any subscription or payment plan; you own the infrastructure, and we provide the expertise to help you deploy and scale it.
With Cloudflare R2, you can store and deliver digital products directly to your customers without relying on centralized platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Our Sovereign Stack consists of Cloudflare R2 for object storage, NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payments, Supabase and Google Sheets for order storage and database, and Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and automation. With our Complete Builder Kit ($197), you get all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack - no coding required. Our expert support team is available to guide you every step of the way, ensuring a seamless deployment process.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your Sovereign Stack today, start by ordering our Complete Builder Kit ($197) from our online shop (https://coremerch.github.io/products.html). Then, follow these simple steps to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack: (1) Set up your Cloudflare R2 account and upload your digital products; (2) Configure NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payments and automatic webhooks; (3) Integrate Supabase and Google Sheets for order storage and database; (4) Create a custom backend with Cloudflare Workers for automated file delivery and processing; and (5) Launch your sovereign digital commerce stack and start selling your digital products directly to customers worldwide.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
By switching to NOWPayments, you can save up to 9.5% on payment processing fees compared to Gumroad's 10% commission.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
